title: dianthus liburnicus var. guliae
intro: Dianthus liburnicus var. guliae, commonly known as Balkan pink, is a plant species within the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Balkan pink include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
